remarks: HOME FOR ALL SEASONS...Located in one of Westport's most desirable Coleytown neighborhoods surrounded by multi-million dollar homes 24 Warnock a perfect blend of style comfort & convenience Turnkey 2851sf home on 4 floors offers close proximity to Westport's top rated schools vibrant downtown, beautiful beaches-an exceptional opportunity at this price point Thoughtfully renovated & impeccably maintained this home exudes quality craftsmanship & modern elegance The chef's kitchen features granite countertops custom cabinetry & premium finishes throughout Three beautifully updated baths combine timeless design w contemporary functionality Open & sun filled main level flows seamlessly to expansive pool deck & blue stone patio-ideal for entertaining/relaxed outdoor living Professionally landscaped backyard truly a highlight featuring a spacious gazebo, firepit, seating area, large hot tub, for year round enjoyment, plenty of room for fun in .40ft pool added in 2020 Recent upgrades include new roof, windows, siding, electrical, plumbing systems, generator & modern HVAC offering peace of mind/lasting value Location is unbeatable- walking distance to Westport's award winning schools, minutes to downtown shops & restaurants Compo Beach & convenient access to Merritt Parkway I 95 & Metro North train 24 Warnock truly checks all the boxes as a turnkey four season home in a coveted neighborhood that captures the best of Westport living Ready-to- move-in or easily expandable.
